footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to StepStone: includes a $148M income tax benefit, $207M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Mar 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 69.7% to $2.0B in fiscal 2026 (ended Mar 31, 2026). The operating loss widened to $1.0B from $267M.
The net loss widened to $536M, or −$6.78 per share, from $180M. Operating cash flow was $66.5M and free cash flow $63.9M, versus $59.8M; StepStone returned $126M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: StepStone Group Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
